artifact_composition.meaning: Git commit and timestamp at which an SSOT artifact or per-cap metadata block was composed or regenerated without claiming a new capability verification event.

actual_verification.meaning: Git commit at which a documented capability verification or test-execution event was performed for this capability. Must not be written from artifact composition, manual HEAD alignment, or SSOT regeneration alone.

status_change_verification.meaning: Verification event bound to an engineering-status transition. tested_sha must match tested_source_sha when both are present on the same event.

validated_through.meaning: NOT_USED. Impact-validation-through semantics are not modeled as a separate writable field in B1-R.

evidence_generation.meaning: Lineage of the artifact or evidence bundle generation pass. Distinct from per-capability actual verification. git.tested_sha is artifact-scope verification baseline, not per-cap tested_source_sha.

tested_source_sha.definition: The git commit SHA at which a documented capability verification event (semantic oracle check, capacity evidence verification, or equivalent recorded test execution) completed successfully for this capability record.
write_preconditions: verification_event.source_sha is a 40-char git commit SHA
verification_event.verification.verdict is not UNKNOWN or FUNCTIONALLY_INCOMPLETE
verification_event.evidence_refs is a non-empty list of strings
verification_event.executed_at is an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp
update_preconditions: Update occurs only as part of a new verification event superseding prior verification provenance
Artifact-only HEAD advance must not mutate tested_source_sha
tested_source_sha.mutability_rule: Mutable only by a new verification event via record_verification_event. Immutable under artifact composition, semantic correction, live-applicability correction, or manual HEAD alignment.

writer_matrix.precondition: SSOT artifact regeneration or metadata alignment
Engineering status transition with verification payload
Artifact-only metadata correction without new verification

invariants: INV-001: tested_source_sha must not change unless record_verification_event is invoked with a valid VerificationEvent.
INV-002: record_artifact_composition must not write tested_source_sha on any capability record.
INV-003: When status_change.verification is present, status_change.tested_sha must equal tested_source_sha.
INV-004: tested_source_sha must not be assigned from git rev-parse HEAD alone without a verification event payload.
INV-005: Verifiers must not treat engineering_status PASS or SSOT verdict PASS as proof of tested_source_sha correctness.
INV-006: Legacy records classified LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS_PRE_B1_R are not auto-normalized or restamped by generators.
INV-007: semantic_correction and live_applicability_correction events must not mutate tested_source_sha.
INV-008: Generator and verifier must load the same contract_version from CAPABILITY_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT.json.
